platforms.purpose: Retrieve arXiv preprints as platform-native papers: versioned identity, metadata, abstract, and full text.
platforms.select_when: The request names arXiv, supplies an arxiv.org URL or arxiv: ref, or needs arXiv papers rather than general web pages.
examples: find recent arXiv papers on retrieval evaluation
查一下 arXiv 上 q-fin.PM 分类最近的论文

platforms.purpose: Retrieve SSRN working papers as platform-native papers: abstract-ID identity, bibliographic metadata, and the abstract when a route has it.
platforms.select_when: The request names SSRN, supplies an SSRN URL, an ssrn: ref, or a 10.2139/ssrn DOI, or needs SSRN papers (finance, law, economics working papers) rather than general web pages.
examples: find SSRN papers on dual momentum
查一下 SSRN 上关于碳排放监管的论文

platforms.purpose: Find papers across publishers through Google Scholar: cluster identity, byline metadata, citation counts, snippets, links to the versions Google Scholar groups together, and the papers that cite a given paper.
platforms.select_when: The request names Google Scholar, supplies a scholar.google.com cluster URL or scholar: ref, or needs cross-publisher academic discovery, citation counts, or the papers citing a known paper, which arXiv and SSRN do not cover; it needs the user's SerpApi key.
examples: search Google Scholar for time series momentum
how often is "Time series momentum" cited on Google Scholar
which recent papers cite "Time series momentum"
在谷歌学术上查一下行为金融学的综述

platforms.purpose: Search and read Xiaohongshu (小红书, RED) notes in the user's own logged-in Chrome: note identity, title, author, publish time, tags, interaction counts, images, the note text, and an access URL that opens the note.
platforms.select_when: The request names Xiaohongshu, 小红书 or RED, supplies a xiaohongshu.com note URL, access_url or xiaohongshu: ref, or needs Chinese consumer experience, reviews, and lifestyle posts rather than web pages; it needs the xiaohongshu_browser route enabled by the user.
examples: search Xiaohongshu for coffee grinder reviews
小红书上最近一周关于露营装备的笔记
find the most liked 小红书 notes about Shanghai cafes
